function confirmResolution({incident,incidentId}){if(!incident||incident.id!==incidentId||incident.status!=='resolved')throw Error('PagerDuty did not confirm resolution');const summary=typeof incident.summary==='string'&&incident.summary.trim()?incident.summary:incidentId;return{announcement:'🎉 The incident ('+summary+') was resolved by the lovely folks in the on-call team!'};}

return {json:confirmResolution({incident:$json,incidentId:$("Validate the action").first().json.incidentId})};
